name: arbiter
description: Research demo by Sentinel Sage: paste a log or ask a cyber question → threat score, action, or short answer. DistilBERT + T5 locally; live DEMO at arbiter.sentinelsage.com. Not a production SOC.

paragraphs: Arbiter — paste a security log or ask a cybersecurity question → get a threat score and recommended action, or a short answer. (Latin arbiter: a judge or decision-maker; this research demo scores and recommends, it does not enforce policy.)

Responsible use: Arbiter is a research demo. It is not a substitute for a production intrusion detection system or SOC. Do not use demo-mode synthetic responses to make real security decisions. Do not paste real production logs, PII, or credentials into the public demo.

There is no third-party labelled SOC / IDS dataset distributed or cited as the training corpus. These weights cannot currently be reproduced from source in this repository. Do not treat outputs as evaluated against a public cybersecurity benchmark.
features: React UI: tabbed console (Analyze, Recent analyses, Q&A history, Guide), threat color indicator, sample logs/questions, session analysis history, browser Q&A history (localStorage), optional speech readout, Demo badge…
Demo mode: synthetic seed data (seeddemo), staff demo user, admin off by default, no visitor log persistence by default.
Env-driven settings (secret, debug, hosts, CORS); throttling; optional server-side X-Demo-Key.
